title: Alvin Kamara doesn't have a chip on his shoulder, but he is motivated

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Alvin Kamara doesn't have a chip on his shoulder, but he is motivated
sources.description: Running back Alvin Kamara agreed to a reported $5.5 million pay cut to stay in New Orleans, because "this is where I wanted to be."
